evidence.decision: Maps gameplay to available built-in and physical inputs, explicitly handles controller-required TV/spatial exceptions, and preserves system/Home behavior and conventional menu actions.
evidence.artifact: Delivers an action/input/player matrix and reachable touch/control layout with active-controller prompts and disconnect handling.
evidence.transformation: The climbing example replaces tiny A/X controls under the Home indicator and mismatched controller glyphs with reachable Grab/Jump actions, active-player glyphs and conventional Back/Pause menus.
evidence.verification: Checks playability on advertised platforms, prompt/controller agreement and reserved-system conflicts, while leaving actual reach, comfort and gameplay responsiveness for device tests.
evidence.applicability: Distinguishes touch, physical controllers, customizable keyboard input and spatial look/reach/trigger semantics; the controller-required exception includes disclosure and absence handling.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Designing for Games for the larger play experience and Gestures for shared manipulation semantics.
evidence.distinctiveness: Player-specific glyphs, controller profiles/disconnection, frequent versus secondary touch target sizes, safe thumb zones and game-menu mappings go beyond a generic input checklist.
